brief: pharmacists in small chemist shops, 30 to 55, at a counter all day, on Android tablets

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), W3C WAI

findings.text: The users are pharmacists aged about 30 to 55 working in small chemist shops.
They stand at a counter all day and use the app between customers.
Android groups 97% of tablets in landscape as expanded width (840 to 1200 dp), so the counter layout should be designed at that size first.
On expanded windows Android recommends a navigation rail beside the content instead of a bottom bar, because it is easier to reach while holding the sides.
WCAG 2.2 asks for pointer targets of at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, for people with physical impairments who cannot hit small, close buttons.

systems.name: Material Design 3
systems.why: the platform's own published system; Android users already know its components
